name: Stainless Steel Field Watch
description: A mechanical field watch with a matte bead-blasted stainless steel case, a cream dial with painted indices, and a woven olive canvas strap.
materials: Matte bead-blasted stainless steel case, mineral crystal, cream dial with painted indices, woven olive canvas strap with a matte steel buckle
primaryColors: Muted gunmetal steel; cream dial face; olive-drab canvas strap
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, wordmark, or printed/engraved lettering on the dial, case back, crown, or strap keeper beyond plain unmarked painted hour indices; no props, no hands, except the wrist required for the worn-scale angle.
preservationNotes: Keep the case shape and size, cream dial layout with matching indices, olive canvas strap weave and color, and matte steel buckle style identical across all four angles.
